sentence_stem: My sister, who works as a doctor in Ankara,
correct_completion: is coming to visit us next weekend.
full_sentence: My sister, who works as a doctor in Ankara, is coming to visit us next weekend.

options.why_wrong: 'That' cannot introduce a non-defining clause after a comma, and this option repeats information already given in the stem.
A second 'who' clause adds more information about the subject but does not give the main verb that the sentence needs.

options.text: is coming to visit us next weekend.

options.why_wrong: This creates a comma splice: the subject 'my sister' has no verb connected to it, and a new subject appears without a link.

grammar_focus: Non-defining relative clauses with 'who' set off by commas
explanation: A non-defining relative clause is set off by commas and adds extra information about a noun that is already clear. It does not complete the sentence, so the main clause still needs its own verb after the clause. Turkish speakers may expect the main verb to follow the subject directly, so remember to finish the main clause after the closing comma.
translation: Ankara'da doktor olarak çalışan kız kardeşim bu hafta sonu bizi ziyaret etmeye geliyor.
